title: SSRF Exploitation
description: Use gopher to reach internal networks and cloud metadata to obtain credentials
detail:
Controllable points: url parameters, webhooks, import features, image loading.
Protocols: file:///etc/passwd, dict://, gopher:// (craft precise mysql/redis/http payloads).
Internal network: first probe 127.0.0.1 and common subnet ports (redis 6379 / mysql 3306 / admin consoles).
Cloud metadata (obtaining it is a major breakthrough):
- AWS: http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/
- GCP: /computeMetadata/v1/ requires the header Metadata-Flavor: Google
Bypasses: 302 redirects, DNS rebinding, decimal IPs, xip.io/nip.io.
